findings.F1: In a falling market, measured by the 60-day return below -10 %, up days are followed by a next-day excess return of -0.63 % (t -2.04 with same-day cases summed, 902 cases on 274 days), with none of 11 windows positive; down days in the same market are followed by +0.25 % (t 0.80), so the fade belongs to the up day itself and not to the market's drift.
findings.F2: Inside that falling market, the fade follows up days that break a down run, not up days after up days: after 0 down days it is +0.12 % (t 0.30, 148 days), after 1 down day -1.08 % (t -1.97, 111 days), after 2 -1.51 % (t -2.28, 64 days), after 3 -0.05 % (t -0.05, 44 days) and after 4 or more -2.84 % (t -3.89, 35 days); it grows with the run but not steadily.
findings.F3: The fade is weaker in the brief's calm profile than outside it: falling up days on calm (in-profile) bars give -0.35 % (t -1.03, 220 days, 4 of 11 windows positive), against -1.05 % (t -2.08, 126 days, 0 of 8 windows positive) on agitated bars; the tested idea's effect lives mainly in falling agitated markets.
findings.F4: In choppy markets up days are followed by -0.55 % (t -1.77, 202 days) and down days by -0.35 % (t -0.73), so the choppy-market negatives are the regime's low drift against the all-window mean, not an up-day pattern; splitting by 20-day depth (lowest tercile -1.07 %, t -1.58) does not stand out either.
findings.F5: Across all bars, the next-day rebound after the largest swing-scaled down days (lowest decile +0.89 %, t 3.84, not day-clustered) and after closes near the day's low (+0.53 %, t 3.90) repeats long reversal ideas the map already holds many times; the weekday spread (Wednesday -0.50 %, Thursday +0.41 %, t about 2.8, not clustered) is one of many angles tried and does not stand out.
findings.F6: The book traded rarely (81 trades, 1 % of coin-days in a position, 160 non-zero book days), with gains concentrated on BTC, ETH, XMR and ZEC (net +1.5 to +1.9 % mean per trade) and small losses on LTC and XRP.

no_ideas: The one pattern that stands out (F1–F3: up days that break a down run fade the next day in a falling market, more so when agitated) is already held by the falling short strategies on the map (074-01.b1.d1.d1 run break fade after sharp leg, 074-01.b1.g1, 060-01.g1.d2.d1), the long reversals (F5) are held many times over, and the choppy-market and weekday readings (F4, F5) do not stand out from chance after the many angles looked at (forecast, run length, 20-day depth, range, close position, weekday, trend by direction, year, book trades).
